description: Popup with text-color and background-color swatch sections (including a default/none option), raising OnColorSelected as a text/background pair where one side is set.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the picker is dismissed without a selection.

parameters.name: SelectedBgColor
parameters.description: Currently active background-color hex, or null for default.

parameters.name: SelectedTextColor
parameters.description: Currently active text-color hex, or null for default.
